built_from: 50 Robin LinkedIn posts + Nick Saraev/Lenny Rachitsky structural extraction

fingerprint.sentence_length: mixed — 45% short punchy sentences (<=8 words), 43% medium (9-20 words), only 12% long sentences. Short sentences punch, medium sentences explain, long sentences are rare
fingerprint.paragraph_length: 1-3 sentences per paragraph. Lists use arrow (→) formatting for items rather than bullet points. Frequent single-line paragraphs for emphasis
fingerprint.opener_style: statement or observation about a tool/event/situation — NOT a question. Bold factual claim or counterintuitive statement. Common patterns: 'X just dropped Y', 'X has/is Z', 'I [personal action or story]'. Rarely uses questions as openers (only 2 of 50 posts opened with a question)
fingerprint.word_choice: direct and concrete — prefers specific product names (Linear, Claude Code, Postel) over abstract terms. Technical vocabulary used naturally, not performatively. Informal contractions (it's, I've, don't) common. Avoids jargon unless specifically relevant to audience
fingerprint.punctuation: minimal em dashes, occasional ellipsis (...) for dramatic effect, parentheticals used in 40% of posts for asides. Arrows (→) for lists. Emojis in 24% of posts — not excessive, usually 1-2 max. No semicolons
fingerprint.first_person: high frequency — 72% of posts use I/my/I've. First person is the default lens: 'I built', 'I quit', 'I tested', 'My biggest mistake'. Authentic personal experience is the credibility signal
fingerprint.cta_style: soft and conversational — invites reflection, asks for others' experience, or shares what worked. Examples: 'Would love to hear what's worked', 'What's missing from this list?', 'Let's talk', 'Happy building'. Never aggressive or sales-y

nick_saraev.post_structure: Bold credibility claim upfront (dollar amount, student count, time period). Then 'here's what I found' pivot. Value via numbered list or short flowing paragraphs. Soft close: 'I put together a full doc/course' or 'reply if you want this'.
hook_formulas: I [extraordinary result]. Here is exactly how I did it.
Most people [common approach]. I tried [different approach] and here's what happened.
I [credibility metric]. The real reason is [non-obvious insight].
engagement_tactics: Lead with specific dollar amounts and percentages as credibility anchors
Long-form value posts that work as carousels
Ends with invitation to get the full resource (doc, course, guide)
Establishes authority before making the ask

lenny_rachitsky.post_structure: Opens with a specific, surprising insight or data point. Shares the 'so what' in 2-3 tight paragraphs. Uses real quotes from named people for credibility. Closes with newsletter/podcast connection.
hook_formulas: [Specific data point with context] — here's what it means for [audience]
engagement_tactics: Named characters in stories create emotional connection
Data + narrative combo (charts or stats plus story context)
Positions reader as insider getting exclusive insight
Short posts that feel like the summary of a longer, deeper piece
